title: eleusine indica var. oligostachya
intro: Eleusine indica var. oligostachya, commonly known as Finger Millet, is a type of small-grained millet crop that belongs to the Poaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include lowering cholesterol levels, improving cardiovascular health, and regulating blood sugar levels. The plant is known for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which make it effective in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Finger Millet include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
